title: Easy Fish Tacos with Slaw
description: Make these fried fish tacos with slaw for Taco Tuesday and impress your family with their fresh, spicy chipotle flavor. You can use any white fish.
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped
2 teaspoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers
1 quart oil for frying, or as needed
1 medium tomato, chopped, or to taste

steps.text: Make chipotle slaw: Mix together coleslaw mix, cilantro, yogurt, peppers, vinegar, adobo sauce, and salt in a large bowl until well combined. Set aside in the refrigerator.

Make tacos: Cut fillets into 2-ounce portions. Season with 1 teaspoon salt, dried cilantro, cumin, and oregano. Allow to rest while combining flour, cornstarch, cayenne, and remaining 1 teaspoon salt in a shallow dish.
Dip each fillet in flour mixture, shaking off excess. Set aside for at least 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 1-inch oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Fry coated fish in hot oil until golden and fish flakes easily with a fork, about 3 minutes per side. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
To assemble, top each tortilla with a fried fillet, 1/4 cup slaw, and slices of avocado and tomato.

video.description: This easy fish tacos with slaw recipe keeps things simple, quick, and delicious! In this video, learn how to lightly fry white fish, whip up a quick slaw mix, and layer everything into a spicy, chipotle-spiced dinner. Top with fresh mango for brightness and enjoy.
